program.name: Field Strength
program.subject: Court & field sports
program.blurb: Strength for contact sports with your dumbbells and kettlebell, each day starting with a jump.
program.about: Strength for field and contact sports, using your dumbbells and kettlebell. Each session starts with a jump while you are fresh, then lifts in straight sets: squats, hinges and lunges one day, presses, rows and carries the other. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds reps on top. Two sessions a week sit well alongside practice.
